title: What If 2,000 Jobless People Got 560 Euros a Month, No Strings?

scenes.text: What if the government paid you every month and asked for nothing? Finland tried it.
From 2017 to 2018, 2,000 unemployed Finns, chosen at random, got 560 euros a month.
It was tax free, and they kept it even if they found a job.
Critics feared people would stop looking for work. Employment barely moved in year one.
Recipients averaged about 50 days worked, versus about 49 for the control group.
But 55 percent rated their health good, against 46 percent. High stress fell from 25 to 17 percent.

description:
What if you got paid with no strings attached?
Finland gave 2,000 jobless people 560 euros a month for two years. Jobs barely changed, but wellbeing rose.
What should we run through next?
